extName.description: The full name, shown in Chrome and as the Web Store listing title. Max 45 characters.

extShortName.description: The short name, used in the panel header, the report, and the zip file name. Max 12 characters. The name is only set in this file.

extDescription.message: Scan the page you have open for accessibility problems, then get a plain-language checklist for the checks a scan can't do.
extDescription.description: Short description shown in Chrome and the Web Store. Max 132 characters.

groupNoFocusConfirmed.message: No visible change when focused (checked on screen)

groupInvisibleFocus.message: Gets focus but cannot be seen

groupMaybeNoFocus.message: May have no visible focus (not checked on screen)

groupPositiveTabindex.message: A tabindex above zero changes the Tab order

groupCoveredBySticky.message: Hidden behind a sticky bar when focused

groupSameAlts.message: Same alt text on different images

groupNoSkip.message: No skip link near the top and no main landmark. A landmark is a marked region, like <main>, that screen reader users can jump to.

noteFocusStops.message: The focus checks visited {stops} of {total} places you can Tab to.

noteFocusCapped.message: This page has {total} places you can Tab to. The focus checks stopped at the first {max}.

noteFocusTime.message: The focus checks stopped at the 20 second limit, after {done} of {total} places.

noteFocusCancelled.message: The focus checks were cancelled after {done} of {total} places. Scan again to run them fully.

notePixelSkipped.message: Chrome did not allow the on-screen check, so the focus results here are less sure.

noteUnreadableSheets.message: Style sheets that could not be read (from another site): {count}. Focus results may be wrong.

autoNothing.message: Nothing found by automated checks. Still check: {still}

autoNeedsScan.message: Scan the page to run these checks.

autoFocusRunning.message: Checking keyboard focus now. Results will show here.

autoFocusFailed.message: The focus checks could not run on this page.

autoKeyboardLimit.message: A script cannot press the Tab key for real, so keyboard traps and how custom controls react to Enter, Space and the arrow keys still need a person.

announceFocusStart.message: Now checking keyboard focus. The page will scroll.

announceFocusDone.message: Focus checks done. Core checks: {good} of {total} look good.

auto_checked_keyboard.message: Everything you can Tab to, things that look clickable but cannot be reached with Tab, and axe rules for keyboard access.

auto_still_keyboard.message: Use Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys on every control, and make sure focus never gets stuck.

auto_checked_focus_visible.message: Each place you can Tab to: whether its look changes with focus, and a before and after screenshot for those that seem not to.

auto_still_focus_visible.message: Tab through the page and make sure you can always see where you are.

auto_checked_focus_not_hidden.message: Whether each focused element is fully covered by a fixed or sticky bar.

auto_still_focus_not_hidden.message: Tab through the page with menus and banners open, and make sure focus is never hidden.

auto_checked_focus_order.message: tabindex values above zero, and places where focus jumps back up the page or backwards along a row.

auto_still_focus_order.message: Tab through the page and make sure the order matches the reading order.

auto_checked_skip_link.message: A same-page link among the first three Tab stops, a main landmark, and axe rules for skipping repeated content.

auto_still_skip_link.message: Load the page, press Tab once, and make sure a skip link appears and works.

auto_checked_link_purpose.message: Links with vague text like "click here", and links with the same text that go to different places.

auto_still_link_purpose.message: Read each link's text on its own and make sure it says where it goes.

auto_checked_alt_text_quality.message: Alt text that looks like a file name, says only "image" or "photo", starts with "image of", is very long, or repeats on different images.

auto_still_alt_text_quality.message: Read each image's alt text and make sure it says what matters about the image.

auto_checked_target_size.message: The size of buttons and links, and the space around small ones (axe's target size rule).

auto_still_target_size.message: Try the page on a phone and make sure nothing is hard to tap.

auto_checked_structure.message: Lists, tables and headings, using axe's structure rules.

auto_still_structure.message: Make sure things that look like headings, lists or tables are marked up as them.

auto_checked_custom_controls.message: Custom controls' roles, names and states, using axe's ARIA rules. ARIA is a set of attributes that tell assistive tech what a control is.

auto_still_custom_controls.message: Try each custom control with a screen reader and make sure it says its name, role and state.

auto_checked_labels_instructions.message: Labels on form fields, using axe's label rules, and fields named only by placeholder text.

auto_still_labels_instructions.message: Make sure every field says what to enter and in what format.

auto_checked_use_of_color.message: Links in text that differ from the text around them only by color.

auto_still_use_of_color.message: Look for anything else that uses only color to show meaning, like red for errors.
